newsitem.title: USA: Oklahoma bomb suspect's mother in mental hospital.
newsitem.headline: Oklahoma bomb suspect's mother in mental hospital.

text.p: The mother of Oklahoma City bombing suspect Timothy McVeigh has been committed involuntarily to a mental hospital, police said Tuesday.

McVeigh's mother, Mildred Frazer, 52, of Fort Pierce, was taken by a friend to the emergency room at Columbia Lawnwood Regional Medical Centre Sunday after Frazer exhibited "psychotic behaviour," Fort Pierce police reports said. Police also recovered a handgun from Frazer, the reports said.

Frazer, a school bus aide, was examined at the hospital and transferred to a neighbouring psychiatric centre, New Horizons of the Treasure Coast, where she was admitted, the reports said. Hospital officials declined to discuss the case, citing patient confidentiality.

Police said Frazer was admitted under the Baker Act, which allows doctors or police to temporarily hold people at mental health facilities against their will if they are considered a danger to themselves or others.
McVeigh is scheduled to be tried March 31 on charges that he bombed the Alfred P. Murrah Federal Building in Oklahoma City in 1995, killing 168 people and injuring about 500.
